title.en: Multivariable derivatives, matrix calculus, and automatic differentiation
title.zh: 多元微分、矩阵微积分与自动微分

lead.en: Distinguish partials from total differentiability, derive correctly shaped Jacobians and matrix gradients, and verify reverse-mode accumulation through shared computations and a two-layer network.
lead.zh: 区分偏导与全微分，推导正确形状雅可比及矩阵梯度，验证共享计算与两层网络反向累积。

prerequisites.en: Module 10: matrix products, transposes and batch shapes; Module 16: local linear models, chain rules, Taylor error and kink boundaries. Modules 11–14 strengthen geometric interpretations but are not required to execute the labs.
prerequisites.zh: 模块 10：矩阵积、转置与批形状；模块 16：局部线性、链法则、泰勒界与折点。模块 11–14 加强几何解释，但实验无需额外先修。

en: Compute partial and directional derivatives and exhibit their insufficiency for total differentiability.
Define the column gradient and output-by-input Jacobian as local linear maps.
Compose Jacobians and identify forward JVP and reverse VJP shapes.
Use Hessians and second-order expansions with mixed-partial hypotheses.
Derive dot-product, general quadratic and least-squares gradients through differentials.
Implement reverse-mode shared-node accumulation and verify all parameter gradients of a two-layer network.
zh: 计算偏导方向导数，给不足保证全可导反例。
将列梯度和输出乘输入雅可比定义为局部映射。
复合雅可比并标前向JVP、反向VJP形状。
按混合偏导条件使用Hessian与二阶展开。
用微分推导点积、一般二次型与最小二乘梯度。
实现共享节点反向累积并检验两层网络全部参数梯度。

text.en: Read Sections 1–2 and test differentiability counterexamples.
text.zh: 阅读第 1–2 节并检查可导反例。

text.en: Read gradients and total derivative selections.
text.zh: 阅读梯度与全导数选段。

text.en: Retrieve every derivative shape and convention.
text.zh: 检索全部导数形状与约定。

title.en: Chain Hessian and matrix gradient proofs

text.en: Read Sections 3–5 and derive differential formulas.
text.zh: 阅读第 3–5 节，推导微分公式。

text.en: Check gradients Jacobians and Hessians numerically.
Read automatic differentiation and explore graph adjoints.
text.zh: 阅读自动微分并探索图伴随量。

text.en: Implement reverse mode and trace shared-node accumulation.
text.zh: 实现反向并追踪共享节点累积。

text.en: Explain JVP versus VJP and derivative conventions.
Verify every parameter gradient and diagnose three faults.
text.zh: 验证全部参数梯度并诊断三类故障。

text.en: Complete choices and the written shape/backward contract.
text.zh: 完成选择及书面形状反向约定。

text.en: Read matrix calculus and computation-graph selections.
text.zh: 阅读矩阵微积分与计算图选段。

text.en: Complete the exit task including accumulation and loss scaling.
text.zh: 带累积与损失尺度完成结业任务。
